smells.finding: mechanical_fields is 48 lines of straight-line field assembly with one nesting level and no branching beyond per-field guards; every helper it calls (_lease_role, _artifact_refs, failed_command_count, reopen_total, manifest_ref, find_spine_path) is separately named and under 35 lines. emit_mechanical_snapshot is 24 lines in one try. Nothing here needs extracting.

No classes added. episode_capture.py grew from ~230 to ~660 lines but stayed one cohesive module with a single responsibility (capture at the seam); the added surface is one composer plus its field readers.

The one near-duplicate is the isinstance(x, int) and not isinstance(x, bool) and x >= 0 guard, which appears three times (rework-count, refusals, and the engine's armed check). Each is two lines inline at its point of use with a different subject; extracting a shared predicate would add an indirection larger than the duplication it removes.

episode_capture reaches deep into checklist_engine internals: it calls the private _collect_changed_files, the private-by-convention active_id, and journal_path, and _rework_total walks the engine's task dicts field by field. On a pure OO reading this is envy - the knowledge lives in the engine.

override.repo_standard: The g2 gate ruling in force, restated in the handoff: the engine diff is an import shim, two call lines and base_dir threading - ZERO LOGIC - and any fix must live in episode_capture.py. Reinforced by episode_capture's own module comment that active_id is imported rather than re-derived so the composer can never disagree with the engine about which step is live.
override.reason: Moving these readers onto the engine is exactly the change the standard forbids, and the alternative to reaching in is re-deriving engine state locally, which the ruling and the module comment both identify as the worse defect (a second source of truth that can drift). The envy is the deliberate price of keeping the engine logic-free, and it is confined to reads with no mutation.

smells.finding: (checklist, base_dir) travels together through most of the new surface, but that is the module's established pair from g1, not a clump introduced here, and each is used independently by several functions (project_name takes only base_dir; _rework_total takes only the checklist).

The composer returns a bare dict[str, Any] of eleven string-keyed primitives and hyphenated keys rather than a typed record, and context-manifest-ref is an f-string of the shape ctx-run-step@revision rather than a value object.

override.repo_standard: docs/EPISODE_STORE.md sections 4 and 8 define the mechanical bin as a FROZEN field group with those exact hyphenated names, and apply_episode_delta._validate_create/MECHANICAL_ALL_FIELDS validates against those literal keys; section 8 fixes the <manifest-ref>@<revision> string contract. The handoff names constraint:frozen-field-group - the group is not mine to redesign.
override.reason: A typed record would have to serialise back to precisely these keys and this string shape at the boundary, so it would add a mapping layer without removing a single primitive from the wire format. The dict IS the documented contract, and the missing-key-means-refused semantics the composer depends on is a property of the dict, not something a fixed-field record could express.

smells.finding: Widest new signature is mechanical_fields(checklist, base_dir=None, spine_path=None) at three, with the third an injection seam the tests use. All other new functions take one or two.

The eleven-field group is now spelled out in five places that must be changed together: episode_capture.mechanical_fields, episode_capture.REQUIRED_MECHANICAL_FIELDS, apply_episode_delta.MECHANICAL_ALL_FIELDS/MECHANICAL_SCALAR_FIELDS/MECHANICAL_INT_FIELDS, query_episodes._FIELD_READERS, and the docs/EPISODE_STORE.md prose. Adding a twelfth mechanical field means five coordinated edits with no mechanism that fails when one is missed. Raised as an OBSERVATION, not a blocker: the group is frozen right now, so the cost is latent rather than live, and consolidating it is a cross-module change well outside this gate's scope. Worth a triage candidate if the group is ever unfrozen.

episode_capture.py changes for one reason only - what gets captured at the seam and how. The refusals counter is the one edit outside that module and it lands in checklist_engine for the stated reason that main() is the only place a refusal is observable at all.

No chains beyond one hop. (item.get('payload') or {}).get('exit') and (checklist.get('tasks') or {}).get(step) are defensive two-step reads over untyped JSON, each guarded against None, not navigation through a chain of objects.

find_spine_path plus journal_reopens - roughly 60 lines including a work_id-AND-items disambiguation heuristic with a silent-None ambiguity branch - exist solely to supply the second argument to reopen_total's max(). My mutation M5 replaced that entire two-witness reconciliation with _rework_total alone and all 63 episode tests stayed green, so the machinery is not merely speculative, it is currently indistinguishable from its own absence. And the one case it was built to handle, the escalated reopen, is the case where it produces a WRONG number rather than a corroborated one (HUNT 1). This is the same finding as the h1-fix-shape ruling for option B, reached independently from the smell side.

The comment-to-code ratio in the new material is extreme - the 29-line engine diff is 26 lines of comment and 3 of code, and several docstrings run 15+ lines of justification per 5 lines of body. On the classic reading, prose this heavy is deodorant over code that should speak for itself.

override.repo_standard: references/global-crew.md and the repo's why-capture doctrine (docs/CHECKLIST_SCHEMA.md why_trail): a decision's REASON is a durable artifact, and the constellation standard is to record why a shape was chosen at the point of choosing, so a later agent with no context cannot casually undo it. The mechanical bin's own doctrine - a plausible wrong number is worse than an absent one - makes the refuse-rather-than-default rationale load-bearing.
override.reason: These comments explain WHY, not WHAT: why the arming sits in claim and after the idempotent-resume early return, why the increment is inside the persistence guard, why the field is run-scoped, why durable_root was rejected for project. None of it restates the code, and every one of these is a decision a future editor would otherwise plausibly reverse. One genuine exception is called out in the review findings rather than here: reopen_total's docstring and test_a_missing_journal_is_covered_by_the_second_witness both assert an invariant (neither witness can over-count) that HUNT 1 falsifies - that is a WRONG comment, which is a correctness defect, not a deodorant one.
